page_title: FRE 1-1 DAR | Freiburg v Darmstadt 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The referee has issued a yellow card to Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
90+3' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+3' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Alexander Brunst shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+2' It is time for a substitution. Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is on for Lucas Holer.
90+2' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) replacing Marvin Mehlem.
90+2' Substitution. Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) on for Mathias Honsak.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' An attempted cross from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is cleared.
88' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' A pass by Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
85' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
82' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Manuel Gulde and he is replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
82' Substitution. Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) replaces Ritsu Doan.
79' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Freiburg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
78' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
75' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
74' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Tim Skarke will be replaced by Emir Karic (Darmstadt).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Seydel departs the field of play to be replaced by Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt).
72' Freiburg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
72' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
70' A cross into the box from Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) is cleared.
69' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
68' Neat passing move from Freiburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
65' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
64' Flag up against Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
63' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) is flagged for offside.
60' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
60' Freiburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
59' The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
58' Torsten Lieberknecht is forced to make a change. Christoph Zimmermann is unable to continue due to injury, Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) comes on.
54' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
51' There's an opportunity for Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
51' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
47' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
41' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
38' The corner is swung in but Darmstadt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
38' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
37' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement.

35' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Matthias Ginter picks out an unmarked Lucas Holer (Freiburg) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
34' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ritsu Doan (Freiburg).
32' A player from Freiburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
31' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
30' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alexander Brunst.
29' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

27' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
27' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
26' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
26' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
26' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
25' 66:34 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
23' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
21' Darmstadt are ruled offside.
18' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Noah Atubolu. He makes it 0:1.
16' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' A long pass, executed by Matthias Ginter (Freiburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
14' Freiburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' The attendance for today's match is 1415.
12' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
11' The ball is cleared after Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.

9' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Freiburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
7' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
6' The ball has crossed the sideline. Darmstadt are taking a throw-in.
5' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
3' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Freiburg.
2' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Brunst comes off his line to gather the ball.
